title: Speaking — Small acts of patience
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on small acts of patience.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
Which everyday situations test your patience?
What do you usually do while you wait?

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when it was worth waiting for something.
part2.closing: and explain why you felt the wait was worthwhile.

questions: How has immediate access to information affected people's patience?
What can public services do to make unavoidable waits less frustrating?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to small acts of patience?
